name: Maria Santos
headline: Senior HR Generalist
summary: HR generalist with 9 years in hospitality and retail, covering recruitment, employee relations, payroll and onboarding for multi-site teams of up to 2,000 people.

experience.title: Senior HR Generalist
bullets: Partner with managers at 14 hotels on hiring, performance reviews and employee relations for 1,800 staff.
Cut seasonal time-to-hire from 6 weeks to 3 with a rolling recruitment calendar and referral scheme.
Track HR requests in a Jira service desk, answering 90% within two working days.
Built Excel turnover and absence reports that the leadership team reviews every quarter.

experience.title: HR Generalist
bullets: Ran monthly payroll for 600 store employees in QuickBooks with zero late payments over three years.
Rewrote the onboarding programme for new store managers, lifting 90-day retention by 12 points.
Kept the headcount and holiday planner in Excel for 22 stores.

certifications: CIPD Level 5 Associate Diploma in People Management
